hints: A decreasing stack represents the unfinished right spine of the maximum tree.
Pop smaller nodes to become the new node’s left subtree; attach the new node as the remaining top’s right child.
For each value, pop smaller stack nodes, link the last popped as left, link from stack top as right, then push.
Each value is pushed and popped at most once, reproducing the same nearest-greater boundaries as recursive maximum splits.
